Name: Broken Farmhouse by glymr
Author: glymr
Description:
The farmhouse Grandpa left you was a lovely old building, but it was neglected for too long. The cellar is musty, the stairs are unsafe, and the rooms are filled with too much junk for you to clear away by yourself. Grandpa will tell you about it in his letter, and Robin and Lewis will discuss it with you when you arrive at Stardew Valley (don't skip the intro!)

When you wake up on your first day, you'll discover a quest chain of twenty-five mini-quests. As you complete each quest, you'll gradually clean out and repair the farmhouse, one room at a time. Some of the townspeople will help you with these quests, earning you occasional small friendship boosts as well as special gifts and rewards. If you follow the mini-quest chain to completion, your house will end up fully upgraded without ever paying Robin a single piece of gold, plus you'll get three renovations for the cost of your labor, some wood, and a few gifts for the townsfolk. There are also seventy-five different flavor texts throughout the farmhouse (and one in the cellar); can you find them all?

The focus of this mod is on making fixing up the farmhouse feel fun and rewarding. It costs much less money, but you'll be required to provide a variety of resources, most of which are easily accessible. Some of the resources are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25467]Si's Extra Crafting Materials[/url], adding extra variety and immersion to the story. You'll also be communicating with various townspeople by letter, sending them notes asking for their help and receiving letters from them afterward. Please pay attention to these letters! They will give you CLUES on how to create the new crafting materials, such as glue, paper, and chain. You can also check the Extra Crafting Materials page on Nexus, which will tell you how to create all of the items if you're stuck. There are two or three different ways to make each of the extra crafting items.

If you're looking for a more immersive playthrough with less of a focus on how much cash you can earn, this is definitely the mod for you. If you feel like the initial farmhouse is unrealistically small, this is the mod for you. If you're looking for fun mini-quests with exciting rewards, this is the mod for you. And if you want to add a little bit more challenge to your next game, this is the mod for you! 

You can also bypass the mini-quest chains by upgrading through Robin as you normally would. HOWEVER, you will miss out on the rewards, gifts, and friendship you would otherwise earn. It is not recommended that you have Robin build any upgrades or renovations until all 25 tasks are completed. The only renovations NOT included in Broken Farmhouse are the living room expansion, the corner room expansion, and the cubby. 

The task chains for each upgrade are:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Completing tasks #1-9 will upgrade your house to Level 1 (you'll have a working kitchen and be able to marry someone the morning after you complete task #9 and receive the "Moving Up" achievement). If you have Robin upgrade your house instead, once it the upgrade is completed the task chain for 1-9 will disappear, and task #10 will appear the next day.
[*]Completing tasks #10-15 will upgrade your house to Level 2 (you'll have a working crib and be able to have children, though it may take 2 nights of sleep to register fully). If you have Robin upgrade your house instead, once the upgrade is completed the task chain for 10-15 will disappear, and the task chains for the cellar and renovations will appear.
[*]Tasks #16 and 17 will complete the corner room (if you have Robin build the renovation instead, these tasks will disappear).
[*]Tasks #18-20 will complete the southern room (if you have Robin build the renovation instead, these tasks will disappear).
[*]Tasks #21-23 will complete the attic (if you have Robin build the renovation instead, these tasks will disappear).
[*]Tasks #24-25 will complete the cellar (if you have Robin build the cellar instead, these tasks will disappear).
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Config Settings (GMCM recommended):[/b]
[spoiler]
[b]Change Grandpa's initial speech?:[/b] True/False
This changes two lines from grandpa's speech at the beginning of the game to make it fit better with Broken Farmhouse. This only changes the text. If you have a mod that changes the graphics, it should be fully compatible.

[b]Change Grandpa's letter?:[/b] True/False
This makes significant changes to the letter grandpa sends that you read at your Joja desk. The changes make the lore fit with Broken Farmhouse a little better, but should also not interfere with other mods that give grandpa more backstory. This only changes the text. If you have a mod that changes the graphics, it should be fully compatible.

[b]Change the first conversation?:[/b] True/False
This makes changes to the conversation between the player, Lewis, and Robin at the beginning of the game. 

[b]Whose to do list is it?:[/b] (Fill in the blank; defaults to "Grandpa's")
Each task is listed as being from "Grandpa's" to do list. Changing the text in this blank will change whose list it is, for example: "My to do list", "Grandma's to do list", "Our to do list", "Uncle's to do List", "Teacher's to do list", "Mary's to do list", etc. Apostrophes are fine, but do not use commas or quotes in this field or it will break things. 
[b]
11th Task Reward (by mail):[/b] Regular Furniture Catalogue/Joja Furniture Catalogue
Shane will send you either a regular furniture catalogue or a Joja furniture catalogue the day after you complete the 11th bundle. This must be changed BEFORE you complete the 11th bundle, even though the letter doesn't come until the next day. (I put this one in mainly because the regular furniture catalogue is also a reward in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26789]Bigger Better Bundles[/url] mod, and I didn't want to duplicate it in both. This way you can get the Joja catalogue instead if you have both mods installed.)

[b]Disable Broken Farmhouse Mod: [/b]True/False 
Disables the Broken Farmhouse mod. This is meant to be used after completing all 25 tasks, in case you want to install a different custom farmhouse without removing the Broken Farmhouse mod. WARNING: If you turn on this setting mid-game, especially before completing bundle 15/upgrading to level 2, it will have a negative impact, like putting you and your furniture in a void space. Please see the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3617]article[/url] on how to add or remove Broken Farmhouse mid-game or more information.
[/spoiler]

[b]Installing on an Existing Save or Uninstalling Broken Farmhouse:[/b]
[spoiler]
It is fine to install Broken Farmhouse on an existing save as long as you follow the directions in this article: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3617]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3617[/url]. The same article also has instructions for uninstalling Broken Farmhouse.
[/spoiler]

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
[spoiler]
Compatible with anything (yes, even Stardew Valley Expanded!) EXCEPT mods that change the early farmhouse layout or mods that add events inside the farmhouse before the second upgrade. After you complete bundle #15 and receive the "Living Large" achievement, the farmhouse layout will be the same as vanilla and any events inside the farmhouse will work normally. At this point you can also use mods that move or change the spouse room or add rooms to the vanilla layout, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12404]Aster's Bathroom[/url]. Because the Level 1 and Level 2 farmhouse layouts are very different from vanilla, it is recommended that you wait to get married until after completing task #15, especially if you are marrying a modded spouse or have a mod that adds extra events inside the farmhouse. Events with children should be fine. 

[b]To Use a Custom Farmhouse After Completing Broken Farmhouse:[/b]
If you want to use a completely custom farmhouse layout, the recommended procedure is to finish all 25 tasks in Broken Farmhouse, wait two nights, read Robin's final "congratulations" letter, then install the farmhouse mod you want to use instead and set the "Disable Broken Farmhouse Mod" config to "true" (if you do this in-game, you may temporarily lose your cellar entrance, but it should reappear next time you exit and re-load the game). You will KEEP all upgrades, rewards, and completed renovations. Best practice when changing farmhouse layouts is always to place ALL furniture and items into a chest outside the farmhouse before installing as described in this article: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3617]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3617[/url].

[b]Using Custom Farm Maps With Broken Farmhouse:[/b]
If you use a custom farm map (like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33731]Beautiful Vista Farm Map[/url]﻿, for example) the farm will work fine, but the furniture and wallpaper of the farmhouse will be replaced by Broken Farmhouse. So the exterior farm will be the custom farm, the interior farmhouse will be Broken Farmhouse.

[b]Using Mods that Change the Look of the Kitchen with Broken Farmhouse:[/b]
Mods that change the way the kitchen looks are fine, but please be aware that mods that change the placement of the fridge, oven, and sink may cause minor issues that break immersion. The sink will be fixed up first (and become a water source), the fridge next (and become a useable fridge) and the oven last (and become a useable kitchen). If the sink and fridge aren't where they are in vanilla, you may find that your oven temporarily becomes a water source, or that you temporarily have more than one refrigerator. Everything should go back to expected behavior once you complete task #9. Mods that change the way the kitchen functions might not work until after you complete bundle #15 (and it may take 2 nights of sleep to fully register the upgrade). 

[b]Broken Farmhouse with Multiplayer:[/b]
Broken Farmhouse is fully compatible with multiplayer, and each farmhand will get their own broken farmhouse to fix up. Players can only complete tasks in their own houses; they cannot complete tasks for each other. Please see the "Known Issues" section below for an additional note regarding multiplayer. 

[b]Android:[/b]
Good news for Android users! While I did not design the mod for Android, according user to AzureList:

"I am an Android user. And this mod works well even though there is one "requirement" to use an older version, namely MMAP, I downgraded it to the August version so that it supports SMAPI 4.2.1 By NRT. Even though on the initial page "a kind of code appears" there is a WARN message, but until now the mod is working smoothly.

So this mod can be used on ANDROID provided the MMAP version is downgraded."
[/spoiler]

[b]Recommended Mods:[/b]
[spoiler]
Broken Farmhouse only changes the interior of the farmhouse. Now SeraphineDreams has created a mod to seamlessly change the exterior of the farmhouse along with Broken Farmhouse! Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3163?tab=files]Broken Version of the Stone Building Mod[/url] (available in Optional Files) and watch the outside of your farmhouse get fixed up, too. The morning after completing To Do List 10 and To Do List 15 you'll see changes in the exterior of the farmhouse. 

I have been told that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43387]Fireredlily's Bathroom Renovation[/url] works nicely alongside Broken Farmhouse, as does [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38127]Simple Seasonal Farmhouse[/url].
[/spoiler]

[b]Version:[/b]
[spoiler]
Broken Farmhouse was created for Stardew Valley 1.6 and above. It is highly unlikely to work on any earlier versions. You are welcome to try to make it work, but please don't report any bugs related to play on earlier versions. 
[/spoiler]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[spoiler]
You will need the latest versions of:[list=1]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25467]Si's Extra Crafting Materials[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url]﻿
[/list]for Broken Farmhouse to work properly. All of these MUST be updated to the most current version. Unlockable Bundles in particular added some brand new functionality that Broken Farmhouse will not work without. 
[/spoiler]

[b]Translations: [/b]
[spoiler]
I welcome translations, however, please do NOT use AI or Google Translate to translate this mod. Also, there is a graphic with text that shows up 25 times; you will need to add a translated version of this banner if you want to fully translate the mod. A blank version of the banner is in the Assets folder under the name "BlankRibbon.png", the original is called "TaskCompletedRibbon.png". Do not re-post the main content of this mod anywhere. You may only post translated versions of the i18n default.json and TaskCompletedRibbon.png files; no other files from my mod may be re-posted. If you'd like me to include your translation directly in the mod, just send it over and I'll be happy to add it.

Special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/elecp]elecp[/url] for contributing the German translation!
[/spoiler]

[b]NO AI Used:[/b]
[spoiler]
No AI was used to make any part of this mod. 
[/spoiler]

[b]Bug Reporting:[/b]
[spoiler]
Please include a log with any reports of bugs. I cannot help you without a log. Logs are SUPER EASY to create! Follow the three simple steps here: [url=https://smapi.io/log/]https://smapi.io/log/[/url], then follow the second set of three VERY EASY steps. If you have trouble creating the log, please post a comment and I will help walk you through it.

For visual issues, a screenshot can sometimes also be very helpful, but logs are usually the MOST helpful. 
[/spoiler]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
[spoiler]

You need to meet someone in person to earn the friendship bonus with them. Even though you'll be 'communicating' with characters through notes and letters, if you haven't spoken to them face-to-face in the game at least once, the friendship bonus won't be applied. 

In multiplayer: Changes which are immediately visible to the player that owns a house won't be visible to other players until after a night's sleep.

If you want an empty cabin to use as storage, I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29606]PIF rooms[/url] instead, as Broken Farmhouse will change the layout of all farmhouses and cabins, and you cannot fix up a cabin which doesn't belong to you. Reports suggest that using "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253]Upgrade Empty Cabins[/url]" will still allow you to upgrade houses that don't belong to you.

After you fix the fridge and the stove (through task #9) you'll be able to access the refrigerator and the cooking options, but your fridge won't be connected, so recipes won't use items in the refrigerator. This will be fixed after one night of sleep.

If you use Chests Anywhere, the fridge may not be available via the Chests Anywhere interface until the morning after you complete task #9.

The spouse room furniture may not show up at first. This is a common problem with farmhouse mods, and the only way to solve it is to finish a day, wait for it to save as normal, and exit the game entirely (to the desktop, not just the title menu). The next time you load the game, the spouse room should be there. If you get married early, you may also have to do this again after finishing task #15. Once you exit and reload after task 15, you should have no further issues with the spouse room not showing up. If you do, please contact me and provide a log. (Logs are easy, I promise! Just follow the steps here: [url=https://smapi.io/log/]https://smapi.io/log/[/url])

The cellar is temporarily filled with water after task #24. When exiting the cellar, the player is warped to the farmhouse doorway instead of the cellar stairs. No one has been able to tell me how to fix this (I would love suggestions!), but it's a minor issue that is fixed after completing task #25. 

If you remove the Corner Room, Southern Room, or Attic after upgrading them, you'll get money for them even though you didn't pay for them in the first place. I don't intend to change this. You're welcome. ^_^

[/spoiler]

--
